eventos.texto: Good morning, Clínica Arenal, you're through to reception. How can I help you today?
Hi, I went over on my ankle yesterday.
Por lo que cuenta (el tobillo), lo encamina a traumatología
Of course. What can I do for you today?
It's swollen and walking hurts. It's swollen and walking Can someone see me
Could I take your full name, and either your DNI or NIE, or the phone number on your file?
Laura Ruiz Gómez born the 14th of September 1978.
493 huecos posibles en traumatología · frenados por regla: Dra. Núria Ferrer (el seguro no cubre esa sede)
Ofrece el lunes 21 de septiembre a las 8:00 con el Dr. Tomás Iglesia en Arenal Sur
Thank you, Laura, I have your record here. The earliest I have is Monday the 21st of September at 8 am with Dr. Tomás Iglesia at Arenal Sur. Shall I book that for you?
